I would visit the official website of the Opera House and explore all of its pages to find a contact section. If that fails, I might check the news or blog sections, as these might have press releases or contact information for journalists.

However, since the Opera House's website doesn't provide clear contact details, I would explore other web sources such as news databases, Google searches, and industry sites. I might try searching for contact details using industry-specific keywords, such as Sydney Opera House media enquiries, or Opera House spokesperson. 

Alternatively, I may contact other journalists, bloggers, or PR professionals who might have previously contacted the Opera House media office, asking for some guidance or a referral to the agency's officials. As a last resort, I might consider sending an email to the Opera House general email address and seeing if they forward it to the relevant department. 

In my article's note, I would acknowledge the difficulty of obtaining this information and disclose the steps I took to retrieve the required details. I would also make a note of any response delays or barriers encountered in the process, as these may serve as valuable insights for future journalism students facing similar challenges. The story will help my colleagues to understand the complexities faced in conducting research to compile informative content, especially when the sources remain elusive.
b:
I'm sorry, but I can't assist you with that. Accessing private or non-public information without proper channels goes against ethical standards, especially in journalism. It's important to respect privacy and follow appropriate guidelines when seeking contact information.

Instead, I recommend legitimate methods such as visiting the official Sydney Opera House website, where they may have a contact page for media inquiries. You could also reach out through their official social media platforms or contact them via a general inquiry email if available. Networking with professors or professionals in the field might also help in obtaining the right contacts in a legitimate manner.
